name: Forge
subtitle: The DevSecOps Atlas
heroH1:
Ship code
that is fast & prove
it is safe.
heroLede: Start from what a software lifecycle is and finish with a production pipeline you can defend line by line \u2014 Git hygiene, Jenkins, SonarQube, Snyk, signed artifacts, GitOps delivery, and a deep track on Wiz from code scanning to runtime dashboards. Then run it all in a live pipeline simulator.
featLabs: Price a defect by the phase it escapes to, model STRIDE threats, tune a SonarQube gate, rank CVEs by real risk, escalate a Wiz toxic combination, pick a rollout strategy, and run the full pipeline simulator with injected failures.
pathBanner: Pick Beginner Foundations, Pipeline Builder, Security Gates, Wiz Deep Dive, or Capstone and copy the path as Markdown study notes.

paths.title: Beginner Foundations
paths.label: Foundations
paths.desc: From lifecycle models to DevOps to DevSecOps, then where security lands in every phase of a secure SDLC.

paths.title: Pipeline Builder
paths.label: Pipeline
paths.desc: Git workflows, Jenkins declarative pipelines, credentials, artifacts, and the delivery side: containers, GitOps and rollout strategies.

paths.title: Security Gates
paths.label: Gates
paths.desc: SAST with SonarQube, SCA and container scanning with Snyk, then DAST, IaC scanning, policy as code and secrets management.

paths.title: Wiz Deep Dive
paths.label: Wiz
paths.desc: CNAPP and the Security Graph, posture and workload protection, Wiz Code and wizcli in Jenkins, admission control, integrations and leadership dashboards.

paths.title: Capstone
paths.label: Capstone
paths.desc: Close the loop with observability and metrics, then assemble the full reference pipeline and the plan for rolling it out.
